title: Personal Support Worker
summary: Provide compassionate, hands-on care to clients in home and residential care settings.
description: We're hiring Personal Support Workers for placements across the Greater Toronto Area. You'll assist clients with daily living activities, monitor and report changes in condition, and provide companionship and dignity-centered care.

title: Nursing Assistant
summary: Support nursing staff with patient care duties in a fast-paced clinical environment.
description: Assist registered nurses with patient monitoring, basic clinical tasks, and documentation. This role suits candidates with formal nursing assistant training seeking Canadian clinical experience.

title: Store Manager
summary: Lead daily operations, staff performance, and sales targets for a busy retail location.
description: Own the day-to-day success of a retail location — team scheduling, inventory oversight, customer experience, and driving sales targets. Prior retail leadership experience required.
requirements: Comfort with POS and inventory systems

title: Visual Merchandiser
summary: Design and execute in-store displays that drive engagement and sales.
description: Plan and install seasonal window and floor displays, maintain visual merchandising standards across the store, and collaborate with marketing on campaign rollouts.
requirements: Eye for layout, color, and brand consistency

title: Chef
summary: Lead kitchen operations and menu execution for a full-service restaurant.
description: Oversee kitchen staff, maintain food safety standards, manage inventory and food cost, and execute menu items to a consistently high standard.
requirements: Red Seal certification or equivalent experience

title: Restaurant Server
summary: Deliver attentive, friendly table service in a busy dining environment.
description: Greet and serve guests, take orders accurately, and provide a memorable dining experience. Evening and weekend availability required.
requirements: Smart Serve certification (or willingness to obtain)
